prompt: In the style of a cinematic film still, the scene unfolds on a weathered shipyard dock under an overcast sky. On the left stands a tall crane operator in a yellow hard hat, leaning against a rusted steel beam. Next to him sits a gray cat with a torn ear, watching intently. In the center foreground, a woman in a blue raincoat holds a rolled-up blueprint, pointing at a specific section for a man in a muddy vest who is looking at the paper closely. Beside them, a black dog with a white patch on its chest sits patiently, tethered by a loose rope to a wooden post. To their right, a young boy in a striped shirt kicks a red soccer ball toward a girl in a pink jacket who is reaching out to catch it. Behind this group, an old fisherman in a wool cap mends a green net, his hands moving deftly through the mesh. A seagull perches on a nearby crate, observing the activity with a tilted head. Further back on the right, two welders in dark protective gear stand near a sparking torch, one holding a shield while the other operates the tool. A foreman in a white helmet walks past them, checking a clipboard held firmly in his left hand. Near the water's edge on the left, a mechanic in oily coverages kneels beside a large diesel engine, wiping grease from a piston with a rag. A parrot in a small cage hangs from a hook above the mechanic, squawking silently. In the background, a cargo ship looms large, its hull painted faded blue. A ladder leans against the ship's side, leading up to an open hatch. A stack of wooden pallets rests near the center, slightly tilted. A bucket of paint sits overturned next to the pallets, spilling white liquid onto the concrete. A wrench lies forgotten near the bucket. There is no sunlight breaking through the clouds. There is no modern smartphone visible in anyone's hand. There is no clear reflection in the puddles on the ground.
